title: DashboardPanelStatusResponse
description: GET /api/dashboards/:id/panel-status (HEL-1786), readable by the dashboard's owner and any editor or viewer grantee (a stranger or unknown id gets the same 404). `items` has one entry per Output panel of the dashboard whose Output and pipeline resolve, in panel order. `sources` holds the distinct source names the per-panel provenance would show for those panels, in first-seen panel order.
